messages:
ellie (Finance): FYI customer sent back an invoice — they say their AP team rejected it because the PO number wasn't in the header and the VAT/tax id ended up only in the footer notes. They need: company legal name + tax/VAT id in the header (top-right), clear PO number in header, and per-line tax breakdown for EU VAT compliance. I attached the PDF sample from the customer. sam (Support): Got it, escalated to finance. Customer ticket: TKT-9921, invoice id 987654. Quote from customer: 'we cannot process without PO top-right and legal entity matching our vendor table.' Can you confirm the exact fields our PDF generator is currently populating? maria (Billing): Current invoice payload uses billing_entity fields. Example we store: { "billing_entity": { "legal_name": "Redwood Inference Ltd", "tax_id": "GB123456789", "address": { "line1": "1 Market St", "city": "London", "country": "GB" } }, "po_number": null } The pdf generator currently prints tax_id in the address block, not the header. We can change mapping but need Eng to touch the template. invoices-bot: pdf-generation failure for invoice 987654 — error: missing field billing_entity.tax_id at template position header.tax_block (retry queued) :warning: devin (Eng): Minimal template change I suggest — move tax block into header, ensure PO prints top-right with label 'PO #:'. Also add fallback to print 'VAT: N/A' if tax_id missing. Example Handlebars-ish snippet:```
{{billing_entity.legal_name}}
PO #: {{po_number}}
VAT: {{#if billing_entity.tax_id}}{{billing_entity.tax_id}}{{else}}N/A{{/if}}
{{#each line_items}}
{{description}} — {{quantity}} x {{unit_price}} — tax: {{tax_amount}} ({{tax_rate}}%)
{{/each}}
``` Also reducing top margin by 8px fixes clipping on customer letterhead. ellie (Finance): That looks right. Important: for multi-entity customers we need to show which legal entity was billed (not just the platform display name). Can we add a small italic note under the header: 'Billed entity: {{billing_entity.legal_name}} (Tax ID: {{billing_entity.tax_id}})' so AP teams can match vendor tables. maria (Billing): Approve the change. Also request that tax totals appear beneath line items as: Tax (VAT @ X%): £Y and Grand Total (incl. VAT): £Z. Many EU customers require tax per line or at least a clear aggregated tax line. devin (Eng): I'll open a PR with the template + unit test that asserts header contains PO and tax id when present and fallback when absent. QA steps: 1) create invoice payload with and without billing_entity.tax_id; 2) generate PDF via /internal/invoices/render endpoint; 3) verify header contains correct strings; 4) run visual diff against golden PDF. I'll link PR once created. sam (Support): After PR lands can we generate a new PDF for invoice 987654 and resend to customer? They asked for a corrected invoice within 24 hours. I'll attach the support ticket to the PR for traceability. :thumbsup: ellie (Finance): Please also ensure the pdf filename format for email is: invoice--.pdf so customer accounting systems can ingest based on filename. devin (Eng): Ack. Will include filename change in PR and add an automated test for filename formatting. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/invoices/pull/412 (draft) maria (Billing): Once PR is merged, finance will validate two customers (Acme Europe & Beta GmbH) and confirm acceptance. sam (Support): Noted — I'll update ticket TKT-9921 and mark as 'awaiting new invoice'.
